design_context: Exploratory design proposed after inspecting A/B1/B2 and already unblinded target domains; not retrospective old preregistration or new unseen-domain validation

support.consequence: retain domain report and C0; no deployable C1 or C2 threshold; label support limitation, not model performance failure

evaluation.wait_definition: FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS[rank 99999] - FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS[rank 0]; availability proxy, not wall-clock annotation latency
FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS[rank 99999] - FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS[rank 0]; availability proxy, not wall-clock annotation latency
FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS[rank 99999] - FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS[rank 0]; availability proxy, not wall-clock annotation latency

C1.zero_optimal_recall: NO_NONTRIVIAL_CLASSIFICATION_SOLUTION; retain degenerate point, no automatic fallback to 0.5

C2.candidates: unique 400 scores plus full-accept boundary and full-reject sentinel
C2.no_solution: NO_FEASIBLE_ACCEPTANCE_THRESHOLD; full reject: coverage=0, risk=NA, effective_attack_detection=0; not a safety success
C2.support_gate: overall 400 records Benign>=20 and Attack>=20; no accepted-subclass gate

C0_select.candidates: union of unique scores from both complete R_select scopes plus full accept/reject sentinels

information_boundary.cross_fold_role_reuse: historical target records may be R_fit in other folds; preserve roles; not new independent samples

later_evaluation_rules.temporal_segments: four contiguous nearly equal window segments, early segments receive remainder; fixed threshold
later_evaluation_rules.bootstrap: new shared per-domain 2000 paired resamples of 10 consecutive complete windows; retain short last block; >=20 blocks; never reuse matrices containing startup
later_evaluation_rules.interval_scope: conditional on one 400-label draw, frozen models and current domains
later_evaluation_rules.metrics_reference: source plan sections 8-9; C1 FPR/Recall/BA and C2 coverage/risk/attack outcomes and native categories; do not select winners by alternate endpoints

numerical_definition.classification: p>=0.5 ALWAYS; no C1 classification threshold read for decisions
numerical_definition.entropy: direct frozen B2.entropy: cupyx.scipy.special.xlogy, float64 CUDA; 0log0=0
numerical_definition.fu: direct frozen B2.predict: torch float64 CUDA sigmoid(beta0+beta1*(u-anchor-mean_offset)/scale)
numerical_definition.score_direction: s>=a; high scores first; no clipping, rounding, reversal or tie splitting

C0_exact_selection.optimization: maximize CA; then minimize CE/CA; then higher score threshold
C0_exact_selection.candidates: all distinct exact score groups in pooled score union + -1 and 2
C0_exact_selection.audit: all-group chunk digests, feasible runs, endpoint counts and selected sufficient statistics; no approximate candidate pruning

bootstrap_execution.samples: independently for each domain draw B block indices with replacement for each replicate; save fresh matrix on shifted evaluation scope
bootstrap_execution.paired: same domain matrix for every model, output and C0/C1
bootstrap_execution.backend: CPU NumPy int64 confusion aggregation and float64 ratios; same block/percentile convention as project
bootstrap_execution.undefined: exclude undefined replicates for each metric, report effective replicate count; no imputing zero
bootstrap_execution.intervals_scope: overall evaluation paired differences only; temporal/calibration are descriptive; conditional on fixed 400-label draw and already unblinded domain

bootstrap_action: reuse C1 matrices by verified absolute reference, no draws
target_label_boundary: all C0/C2 thresholds frozen before target evaluation; development domains have historical cross-fold target roles; no claim of never-seen labels
